[[File:Naval_style.png|thumb|right|300px|The [[Guarlara (Venator-class)/Legends|''Guarlara'']] and the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] in a broadside battle.]]
'''Broadside battles''' were a type of warfare employed during naval battles, both in space and at maritime levels. The battle involved two ships on opposing sides flying across from each other and then each ship firing its main cannons towards the other side of the ship until one of the vessels, or even both, sustained sufficient damage for it/them to no longer be functional.

During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] nearing the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Guarlara (Venator-class)/Legends|''Guarlara'']] entered a broadside battle against the modified [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], the flagship of the Separatist forces, an action that nearly resulted in [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] deaths due to the ''Invisible Hand'' sustaining heavy and irreparable damage from the battle.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], several ships in both the Rebel fleet and [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] entered several broadside battles; the former doing so in order to delay the Death Star II's superlaser firing protocols (as the Imperials are unwilling to risk hitting any of their own ships with the superlaser), an action that, due to the unprecedented nature of the circumstances of the broadside battles, was described as "chaotic."<ref name="ROTJn">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars: Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref>

During the [[Battle of Orinda]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnoughts]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' and the [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']] exchanged a broadside battle.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
